events.title: Flowers to Honey releases November 9!
events.summary: We’re happy to finally announce that Flowers to Honey will release on November 9!Over the past months, we’ve been working on expanding the game beyond the demo, adding more content, improving progression, polishing existing systems, and bringing everything closer to the experience we want for the full release.There are now just two months until release, and we’ll be spending that time polishing the game and preparing everything for launch.If you’ve played the demo, thank you for all the feedback
